correctness.rationale: A common intact length-ell factor synchronizes two rotation-equal deletion outputs when 2ell<=n and all original cyclic ell-factors differ. Its unique origin roots both deletions; equal linear deletions imply a constant interval and hence one cyclic run. Random cyclic factor-match constraints form ell-edge forests for ell<=n/2 and impose exact probability q^-ell. Union bound gives TV control. Proper cyclic-coloring polynomial determines the exact reference distribution, pairwise independent edge changes its moments, and n-1 fully independent change indicators yield a CLT. The packaged verifier exhaustively corroborated 32764 binary words through 14, 9837 ternary through 8, and 5456 quaternary through 6; finite data alone are not proof.

value.rationale: Cyclic rotation can merge deletions from different runs so the familiar linear run law is invalid without source synchronization. A local uniqueness certificate yields a constructive all-source criterion and sharply controlled approximation to an explicit stochastic deletion-outdegree law at any fixed alphabet size, including full reference distribution, mean/variance and Gaussian scale. The precise random cyclic support statistic is motivated by zero-error circular deletion observations and has meaningful use beyond a trivial reparametrization of the linear result.
